arguments.message: No, the old key stays active until you explicitly revoke it. When you generate a new key it doesn’t automatically disable the old one – both keys can be used at the same time. The usual practice is to deploy the new key, confirm it works, and then revoke the old key from Settings → Developer → API keys. That way you avoid any downtime.
